=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py:208-211 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_commit_authorization` accepts a non-empty but malformed `merged_at` string.
  WHY: An improperly merged PR with malformed metadata can pass the truthiness check and be treated as valid; GLM and DeepSeek disputed this as an unrealistic API response.
- scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py:226-238 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `pr_commits_truncated` triggers at 250 commits even though pagination can fetch and inspect up to 300.
  WHY: PRs with 250-299 commits are held as unverifiable despite all commit subjects being inspected; severity differs, with Gemini rating it major and DeepSeek and Qwen rating it nit.
- scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py:317-318 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_carry_forward` reads the template file without handling a potential `FileNotFoundError`.
  WHY: If the file is missing when read, the script can terminate with a traceback instead of a structured error; GLM disputed that this path can be reached for deleted templates.
- scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py:362-371 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: If the push fails after an existing ready PR is converted to draft, the PR remains a draft with stale content.
  WHY: The caller returns failure after the conversion, leaving the stale draft visible until a later successful sync.
- .github/workflows/sync-claude-live-copies.yml:52 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The alert step runs only when `steps.sync.outputs.held == 'true'`, so a sync crash before `_write_outputs` produces no alert.
  WHY: The held output is absent on that crash path, leaving the held-PR alert silent.

  WHY: The held-branch PR opens as a draft, triggering the operator alert, when every commit subject was actually verified across those pages.
